title: Thapa2025: Freewill reach-and-grasp motor-execution dataset from Thapa et al. 2025
description: A large EEG database of self-paced (freewill) reach-and-grasp motor execution, recorded from 23 healthy right-handed participants across 49 sessions. Participants freely chose one of four cups and the timing of movement, yielding 6808 trials in four target classes. Data were recorded with a 31-channel EEG cap plus EOG and auxiliary channels, and are intended for brain-machine interface research. This BIDS version was re-released via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 250 Hz with a Brain Products actiCHamp Plus amplifier and actiCAP snap active gel electrodes (31 EEG channels, 4 EOG, plus accelerometer and audio cue channels), referenced to Cz. Participants performed self-paced reach-and-grasp movements toward one of four cups (two water-filled, two empty), with audio cues marking start and end of each trial, in 5 runs per session.
